instruction: Use EAGLE for the board edit/save and a text editor only for the requested summary file. Before starting the work, start EAGLE from `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` and open `board.brd` there. Look at `board.brd`, use the bundled `testpad.lbr` to add test-point elements, save the updated board as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd`, and write the added-test-point summary to `/home/user/Desktop/testpoint_list.txt`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd` must parse as well-formed XML. 2. Add at least 2 new elements whose refdes starts with `TP_`. 3. At least one `TP_` element must be connected to the `VCC` signal. 4. At least one `TP_` element must be connected to the `GND` signal. 5. Every starter-board element must remain present. 6. The element-count increase must equal the number of added `TP_` elements.
